messages:
maya: Heads up: CI microbench on PR #18422 shows a consistent +18% p50 latency regression for short sequences on quantized models. Failing threshold.
perf-bot: Regression detected on pr/18422 -> microbench-quant/concat_latency p50 +18% (baseline 12.5ms -> 14.8ms). See artifact link.
alex: Oof. Does it repro locally for anyone else?
maya: Yes repros on my devbox. Quick run below.
```
# baseline (main @ a1b2c3)
benchmark concat_quant_short_seq --p50
12.5ms

# PR 18422 (kernel selector scoring tweak)
benchmark concat_quant_short_seq --p50
14.8ms
```
sam: Hmm. Looks like concat got routed to `generic_copy` kernel instead of `fused_concat_quant`. kernel-autoselect scoring changed recently?
jordan: I did a local bisect. The regression lands on commit 9f7e4b — that one increased weight on memory_bandwidth in the selector.
maya: Confirmed with `git bisect` -> 9f7e4b. Can someone grab the CI perf log artifact?
ci-bot: CI artifact uploaded: s3://ci-artifacts/18422/bench/concat_quant_short_seq.log
alex: Quick profile (devbox) shows an extra memcpy around the concat path. stack snippet: 
```
fused_concat_quant() +0x120
generic_copy() +0x34
kernel_dispatcher() +0x58
```
sam: That makes sense — the new scoring bumped up memory-bound kernels for short seqs and the selector prefers generic_copy (lower codegen overhead) even though fused path wins for quantized layout.
maya: We should patch selector to prefer fused_concat for quantized dtype/layouts; temporary revert of the scoring tweak might be safest to unblock rollout.
jordan: Agree. I can reproduce the exact threshold where behavior flips (seq_len <= 64 + small batch).
sam: I'll open a targeted PR that adds an explicit rule: if dtype==qint8 and op==concat -> prefer fused_concat_quant. Smaller than a full revert.
maya: Can we run the microbench suite in shadow mode on main to validate?
sam: Opening PR now -> 18450 includes scoring tweak revert + explicit rule. Kicking off CI.
perf-bot: PR 18450 CI results: microbench-quant/concat_latency p50 = 12.6ms (baseline 12.5ms) — within threshold.
maya: Thanks. Rollout blocked until this lands; marking as rollback-needed in the rollout board.
alex: For postmortem, let's capture: selector change, missing heuristic for quantized fused kernels, no microbench coverage for small-seq quant concat. I'll draft follow-up. Assign to sam for permanent fix + unit test.
sam: On it — will add a unit test asserting quantized concat dispatch and a shadow microbench job for short sequences.
jordan: Also let's add an auto-test in the CI golden to catch this class of regression (quantized fused vs generic).
maya: Agreed. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
